title: SOFIA ✈ SAN FRANCISCO
intro: It started as a post-fundraise trip. It became a second base.

entries.text: First trip, right after the $4.5M raise. Came back and told 150+ people everything at 'Straight out of Silicon Valley'.
Nearly missed the plane in Zurich — 'last call for Mr Belakov'. Made it. Won $1K at a YC startup's hackathon the same week.
Got denied entry to an afterparty at LinkedIn Tower. Ended up at an Ollama + Exa event instead. Better crowd anyway.
Launched Juma at True Ventures' HQ. Hosted my own curated founder event.
Oct–Dec: not visiting anymore — living there, building there. Landed in Sofia and went straight to an AIE.F event the same night.

closer: SF is a mindset. If you are in tech, you need to visit at least once. It will change how you think.
